adaptive_localization.selection_rule: choose the next point only from execution-level safety-probe evidence

author_metadata_request: What ss-PBCH-BlockPower or equivalent SSB EPRE was signalled during each test?
Does NEMO RSRP represent beam/SSB RSRP, cell-level RSRP, or antenna-combined RSRP, and what filtering is applied?
Why is Pathloss (NR SpCell) empty in all UE files, and can a populated export be supplied?
What gNB conducted power, antenna/cable gains, EIRP, and UE calibration or combining assumptions apply?

conditional_safety_probe.fail_action: stop and do not localize farther into positive ploss
conditional_safety_probe.label: positive_ploss_safety_and_interaction_probe
pass_conditions: all requested controls are read back exactly
no numerical clipping, overflow or unstable RFsim process is observed
attachment and telemetry quality gates remain operationally interpretable
RSRP response is monotone at each tested noise level within execution uncertainty
interaction with SINR is reported at the execution level

definitions_not_equivalent.action: prohibit absolute-RSRP calibration or add an explicit discrepancy parameter
definitions_not_equivalent.trigger: NEMO and OAI quantities cannot be made physically equivalent

insufficient_metadata.action: contact authors and keep absolute-RSRP calibration prohibited
insufficient_metadata.trigger: required UPV power, filtering, combining or pathloss metadata remains unavailable

no_offset_positive_ploss_valid.action: run the frozen safety probe before adaptive localization
no_offset_positive_ploss_valid.trigger: no physical offset is supported and simulator gain probing is scientifically accepted

verified_offset.action: rerun existing-bank support before requesting POWDER
verified_offset.trigger: independently justified offset with sign, provenance and uncertainty

next_action: obtain or assess independent measurement metadata; do not compute v2 distances or request POWDER until a branch is selected

frozen_components: feature order within the selected measurement branch
block bootstrap rule, repetitions and seed

opening_conditions: one measurement branch has been explicitly selected and frozen
the branch requires new RFsim executions
the exact next experiment and stopping rule are committed
the user has received a start-reservation notice at least 30 minutes in advance
